scope: Proposition 7.4 (Transport on a real arc) of the manuscript “Cardy’s formula for critical Poisson–Voronoi percolation” (preprints/Cardys-formula-for-critical-Poisson-Voronoi-percolation-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 224 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1334302b31272ae0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 51. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Simultaneously for X = Q, V and every qualified ordered arc from s to t contained in B(x, 2R), with |zs − zt| ≥ R/3 and complementary rim reaching outside B(x, 4R), one has ⏐ ⏐ ⏐IX(P; s, t) − aX h (zt − zs) − ϕX,+ s (σ′ s) − ϕX,− t (σ′ t) ⏐ ⏐ ⏐ ≤ CRh(1 + | log h|2 ) (7.1) outside events whose probability tends to zero in the ordered limit. The constant is independent of the complexity and conditioning constants of the individual fixed comparison patterns.
